# Big Boys Junk Removal: Full Reference

> Fast, affordable junk removal across Metro Atlanta & North Georgia. Instant upfront pricing, same-day pickup, fully insured crews.

## About

Big Boys Junk Removal is a modern junk removal service operating across Metro Atlanta and North Georgia. Customers get instant, transparent pricing online: no waiting for estimates. The service covers residential and commercial junk removal with same-day availability, professional uniformed crews, and eco-friendly disposal practices.

## How It Works

1. Enter your ZIP code to confirm service availability.
2. Choose a pricing method: price by individual item or by load size.
3. Select items or estimate your load using an interactive visual tool.
4. See your exact price instantly: no hidden fees.
5. Book a pickup time. Same-day slots are often available.
6. Our crew arrives, loads everything, and cleans up.

---

## Services

- [Furniture Removal](/services/furniture-removal): Couches, tables, dressers, desks, chairs, bookshelves, and more.
- [Appliance Removal](/services/appliance-removal): Refrigerators, washers, dryers, dishwashers, stoves, and other household appliances.
- [Mattress Removal](/services/mattress-removal): All mattress sizes, box springs, bed frames, and headboards.
- [Hot Tub Removal](/services/hot-tub-removal): Full hot tub and spa demolition and hauling.
- [Yard Waste Removal](/services/yard-waste-removal): Branches, brush, leaves, dirt, sod, mulch, and storm debris.
- [General Junk Removal](/services/junk-removal): Household junk, garage clutter, basement cleanouts, and miscellaneous items.
- [Garage & Basement Cleanouts](/services/cleanouts): Full cleanout services for garages, basements, attics, and storage units.
- [Construction Debris Removal](/services/construction-debris): Drywall, lumber, tile, concrete, and renovation waste.

## Volume Discounts

Discounts are applied automatically to the itemized subtotal:

- $200-$299 subtotal → 5% off
- $300-$499 subtotal → 10% off
- $500+ subtotal → 15% off

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How much does junk removal cost?
Pricing depends on what you need removed. Individual items start at $10 (per box) and go up to $500 (hot tub). You can also price by load size, starting at $99 for a 1/8 load up to $649 for a full load. Volume discounts apply automatically for larger orders.

### Do you offer same-day pickup?
Yes. Same-day and next-day pickup slots are frequently available. Book online and choose the earliest available time.

### What items can you remove?
We remove nearly everything: furniture, appliances, electronics, mattresses, yard waste, construction debris, hot tubs, pianos, exercise equipment, office furniture, and more. See the full item list above. For unlisted items, use our custom item request feature.

### Are you licensed and insured?
Yes. Big Boys Junk Removal is fully licensed and insured. Our crews are professional and background-checked.

### How does pricing work?
You choose one of two methods: (1) **By Item**: select individual items from our catalog of 90+ items and see per-item pricing instantly, or (2) **By Load Size**: estimate your load using a visual trailer diagram. No hidden fees: the price shown is the price you pay.

### Do you recycle or donate items?
Yes. We practice eco-friendly disposal. Items in good condition are donated to local charities. Recyclable materials are taken to appropriate facilities. We aim to divert as much as possible from landfills.

### What areas do you serve?
We serve Metro Atlanta and North Georgia, including Atlanta, Marietta, Roswell, Alpharetta, Sandy Springs, Decatur, Suwanee, Buford, Lawrenceville, Kennesaw, and Smyrna. Enter your ZIP code to confirm availability.

### Can I get a price without calling?
Absolutely. Our entire pricing system is online. Enter your ZIP code, select your items or load size, and see your exact price instantly: no phone call or in-home estimate required.

### Do you charge extra for stairs or heavy items?
Optional add-ons are available: stairs (+$25), heavy items over 200 lbs (+$40), and disassembly (+$30). These are clearly shown before you confirm your booking.

### What is your customer rating?
We maintain a 4.9-star customer rating based on verified reviews.
